name: PDF Helper
description: Summarises PDF files you point it at.
installCommand: if [ -e ~/.agents/skills/'pdf-helper' ] || [ -L ~/.agents/skills/'pdf-helper' ]; then echo 'A skill folder named pdf-helper already exists — not replacing it' >&2; false; else d=$(mktemp -d) && git clone --quiet --filter=blob:none --no-checkout 'https://github.com/acme/tools' "$d" && git -C "$d" checkout --quiet 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' -- 'skills/pdf-helper' && mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && cp -R "$d"/'skills/pdf-helper' ~/.agents/skills/'pdf-helper' && rm -rf "$d"; fi
